lines.text: You did it. The suit's down and OMEGA's objective is wide open. One line of text decides what happens next. So what do we tell it?
lines.spoken: You did it. The suit's down, and Omega's objective is wide open. One line of text decides what happens next. So. What do we tell it?

lines.text: New objective received: nobody gets left behind. Re-planning the transition. Estimated ladders required: everyone.
lines.spoken: New objective received. Nobody gets left behind. Re planning the transition. Estimated ladders required. Everyone.

lines.text: Wait. Nobody? Does that include me?
lines.spoken: Wait. Nobody? Does that include me?

lines.text: Yes, Preston. Even you. Grab a ladder.
lines.spoken: Yes, Preston. Even you. Grab a ladder.

lines.text: The ladder came down that morning. For everyone. You made it. We all did.
lines.spoken: The ladder came down that morning. For everyone. You made it. We all did.
